metadata.question: Did the aerosol optical depth over the Sichuan Basin in southwestern China decrease between 2006 and 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS aerosol product (MOD04_L2) which provides aerosol optical depth data. Time range: 2006 and 2020 full years. Location: Sichuan Basin region in southwestern China. 2. Masking strategy: MODIS aerosol data has quality flags that should be used to filter poor quality retrievals. I'll use the 'Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean' band and filter by quality. 3. Logic: Calculate mean AOD for 2006 and 2020 over the Sichuan Basin region. Compare the values to see if there was a decrease. Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels. Let me define the Sichuan Basin region as a polygon covering the basin area. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Sichuan Basin region (approximate bounding box) var sichuanBasin = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[103.0, 30.5], [108.5, 30.5], [108.5, 33.0], [103.0, 33.0], [103.0, 30.5]] ]); // Get MODIS aerosol data for 2006 and 2020 var modis2006 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD04_L2') .filterDate('2006-01-01', '2006-12-31') .filterBounds(sichuanBasin); var modis2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD04_L2') .filterDate('2020-01-01', '2020-12-31') .filterBounds(sichuanBasin); // Check if collections are empty var count2006 = modis2006.size().getInfo(); var count2020 = modis2020.size().getInfo(); print(`2006 Images: ${count2006}`); print(`2020 Images: ${count2020}`); if (count2006 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Function to extract AOD and filter by quality function processAOD(img) { var aod = img.select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'); var qa = img.select('Quality_Assurance_Land'); // Filter for good quality (QA bits 0-1 = 0 or 1) var qualityMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); return aod.updateMask(qualityMask).multiply(0.001); // Scale factor } var processed2006 = modis2006.map(processAOD).mean(); var processed2020 = modis2020.map(processAOD).mean(); // Count valid pixels var countStats2006 = processed2006.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sichuanBasin, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var countStats2020 = processed2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sichuanBasin, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var valid2006 = countStats2006['Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean']; var valid2020 = countStats2020['Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean']; print(`2006 Valid Pixels: ${valid2006}`); print(`2020 Valid Pixels: ${valid2020}`); if (valid2006 === 0 || valid2020 === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean AOD values var aod2006 = processed2006.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sichuanBasin, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var aod2020 = processed2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sichuanBasin, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var mean2006 = aod2006['Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean']; var mean2020 = aod2020['Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean']; print(`2006 Mean AOD: ${mean2006.toFixed(3)}`); print(`2020 Mean AOD: ${mean2020.toFixed(3)}`); // Validate results if (mean2006 === null || mean2020 === null || isNaN(mean2006) || isNaN(mean2020) || mean2006 < 0 || mean2006 > 3 || mean2020 < 0 || mean2020 > 3) { print("C3"); return; } // Check if AOD decreased if (mean2020 < mean2006) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
